steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: Here is one job in the ConstructHUB CRM, from the first call to the final payment.

steps.caption: Leads
steps.narration: Every job starts as a lead on the pipeline.

steps.caption: The Hadley job
steps.narration: This one is the Hadleys' new floor, in Austin. It has moved along to Scheduled.

steps.caption: The client's page
steps.narration: Open the client, and the whole job is on one page.

steps.caption: Quick actions
steps.narration: Quick actions start the next step: a visit, an estimate, a payment.

steps.caption: The estimate
steps.narration: The estimate went out by email. You can see when they opened it, and when they approved.

steps.caption: Estimate lines
steps.narration: Each line came from the price book, with its quantity and its price.

steps.caption: Signed
steps.narration: Nora approved it online by typing her name. Now it is a signed contract.

steps.caption: Schedule
steps.narration: Next, the visit goes on the schedule.

steps.caption: The visit
steps.narration: Open it for the time, the client, and who is going.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: The crew sees it on their own calendar.

steps.caption: Back to the client
steps.narration: On site, the crew shoots photos with JobCam.

steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: Each shot is filed to this client's job.

steps.caption: Create invoice
steps.narration: When the work is done, choose Create invoice on the approved estimate.

steps.caption: The invoice
steps.narration: The invoice is made from the estimate, ready to send.

steps.caption: Record payment
steps.narration: When the check arrives, choose Record payment.

steps.caption: Record it
steps.narration: Check the amount, and record it.

steps.caption: Paid
steps.narration: The invoice is marked paid, and the client gets a receipt by email.

steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: Lead, estimate, signature, schedule, photos, invoice, paid. One job, in one place.

steps.caption: Where to start
steps.narration: The CRM is its own product, with its own plans. See them at ConstructHUB dot U S.

youtube.title: ConstructHUB CRM in 2 minutes: one job from lead to paid
youtube.description: One job in the ConstructHUB CRM from start to finish. A lead on the pipeline becomes an estimate the client approves online by typing their name. The visit goes on the schedule, JobCam files the crew's photos to the job, and the approved estimate becomes an invoice that is marked paid when the check is recorded. Everything shown is a demo workspace with made-up clients.
